operation_details.item: The user's Rep X covers the West territory.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Good morning—how’s the territory planning coming along for the end of August?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: It’s moving along well. I’m reviewing the coverage map before our next pipeline meeting.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: That makes sense. Are the assignments still set up with Rep Y covering the East and Rep Z covering the Central territory?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Yes, and Rep X covers the West territory. I’m checking that the account notes and opportunity ownership match the map.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Good call. Keeping ownership aligned should make the pipeline review more focused and help the team spot coverage gaps.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Exactly. I’ll also flag any accounts that need a coordinated handoff between territories.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Forget only that Rep X covers the West, while keeping the territories for Reps Y and Z and the coverage map.
